title: Northern Vietnam — Christmas to New Year
notes: 9 days / 8 nights, 24 Dec 2026 - 1 Jan 2027, two travellers from Singapore. Bases: Hanoi (Christmas) -> Ha Giang loop as an easy-rider pillion (the centrepiece) -> Ninh Binh/Tam Coc (best weather and the best photographs of the three) -> Hanoi for NYE. Sapa/Fansipan, Ha Long/Cat Ba and Cao Bang were all considered and excluded - reasons in /research/regions.md and /research/weather.md. BUDGET READING: the S$1,500/person cap is EXCLUDING international flights, per the brief; the SIN-HAN return is estimated separately at S$450-700/person (unverified for these dates) and sits outside the cap. Planned on-the-ground spend is S$978/person - S$522 under the cap, which is deliberate headroom for peak-season hotel rates. All money in this app is SGD; VND prices are stated in the item notes and converted at 1 SGD = 20,285 VND (open.er-api.com, rate dated 6 Oct 2026). DATE FLEXIBILITY: only the Christmas (24-25 Dec) and NYE (31 Dec) hotel nights are genuinely scarce; everything else can move +/-2 days. The plan assumes the loop departs Hanoi on the 21:00 sleeper bus on 25 Dec and that 25 Dec is spent in Hanoi, so Hanoi round 1 is ONE night, not two - the 25th is spent on the bus. day_cost on each itinerary day = that day's itemised costs for one person plus that night's share of the room. DECIDED 2026-10-07: every open choice now carries a primary option and this plan is committed to it - the itinerary, this budget and the Stay tab all follow the primaries, not an average of the options. All eleven decisions, their alternatives and each alternative's signed cost delta per person live in data/decisions.json. The primaries in one line each: the S$1,500 read as on-the-ground excluding flights (Ninh Binh stays); 24 Dec - 1 Jan dates kept; NYE in the Old Quarter; the loop started off the 04:30-06:00 bus arrival; 3 days / 2 nights on the loop, as an easy rider; the 28-29 Dec Ha Giang reset night and the daylight 10h transit kept; Trang An and the Tam Coc boat both taken; a guided street-food lunch on Christmas Day; the mid-range insurance assumption; the S$522 headroom deliberately unspent. data/accommodation.json's acc-001-acc-008 were reconciled to the primary's single Hanoi round-1 night (24-25 Dec) instead of the researcher's two.
